jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production transparent sprite atlas, fresh native high-resolution anime SD illustration. IMAGE1 is the exact16-pose and direction reference. IMAGE2 is ONLY the premium anatomical/style reference: copy its large skull/face-to-body ratio, compact torso, short limbs, chunky red shoes, crisp thick ink contours and clean cel shading. Redraw each pose from IMAGE1 with IMAGE2's anatomy, never replace IMAGE1 poses with IMAGE2 idle poses. Same Farah identity, green bob hair, green eyes, red sleeveless crop top, orange loose martial-arts trousers, red gloves and red chunky boots. Preserve the specific pose, head/eye direction, hand gesture and extended leg/foot role of each source cell. Use exactly4columns x5rows on a native1122x1402 transparent canvas. Exactly16 separate whole figures occupy rows1..4; row5 completely empty transparent. Direction order EACHROW: front, back (face hidden), right-facing profile (face visible), left-facing profile (face visible), except retain the face exposure of the source lying poses. Each figure centered in its owncell, safe transparent gaps at least20px between strong silhouettes, at least15px outer margin, no neighboring contact. Upright figures should have the same native head/body scale as IMAGE2, roughly235-245px high; crouched and lying poses must naturally be shorter, do not enlarge them to fill their cells. Keep kicks/punches complete with enough transparent clearance. Ignore stray duplicate foot/hair fragments between cells in IMAGE1 extraction; draw only the16 complete intended figures. True alpha0 background, no ground/shadow/VFX/text/borders/grid. No weapons added, no pose/order changes, no mirrored rear/front confusion, no photoreal shading or blur.
Pose rows from IMAGE1: row1 walk stride with first leading foot and arm swing; row2 complementary stride with the opposite leading foot/arm; row3 hit recoil leaning backward with arms spread and pained face, backcell face hidden; row4 unconscious lying face-down/on side with eyes closed, exact head-to-feet orientation and face visibility from IMAGE1. Preserve the difference of both walk strides. Do not stand up the lying row, do not rotate its body. Keep all figures including death poses at same head and boot size; lying poses naturally much shorter.
jobs.visualReview: Directly viewed16 figures: two distinct arm/stride sequences, recoil row with pained expression and four lying dead poses preserved. Side profiles remain face-visible; back rows face-hidden where source does. Same skull and chunky boot style through standing/recoil/lying; lying figures naturally shorter. No apparent clipping. Render/PPU continuity pending.
